worldview.title: Worldview
items: Worldview is the core context for AI writing
Fill in basic settings before you start writing

storyCore.title: Story Core
items: The story core defines the main conflict and theme
Clear protagonist motivation helps AI maintain character consistency

powerSystem.title: Power System
items: Clearer power tiers lead to more coherent battle scenes
List the protagonist's current tier and breakthrough conditions

history.title: History Timeline
items: Historical events provide timing references for foreshadowing
Highlight key nodes that affect the current plot

rules.title: Writing Rules
items: Writing rules are appended as system prompts to all AI requests
Keep rules concise for best results

backup.title: Version History
items: Create manual snapshots to save important versions

export.title: Export
items: Supports Markdown, TXT, and JSON formats
JSON preserves full project data for restoration

settings.title: Settings
items: DeepSeek is recommended for lower cost
API Key is session-only by default; enable "remember on this device" to persist in localStorage. AI requests go to the selected model provider.

info.title: Project Info
items: Project info is included in AI context
Target word count tracks writing progress
